universal_checks.criterion: The declared authoritative source exists and is readable.
A stable version or revision is recorded.
SHA-256 matches the exact bytes under review.
The required reviewer is named and appropriately assigned.
A type-appropriate validation report identifies method and outcome.
Source, derivation/provenance, and rights basis are documented.
No unresolved defect or blocking condition remains.
Intended production use and scope are explicit.
Named approval applies to this exact version/hash and purpose.
Required dependencies are identified, versioned, and available.
No unapproved substitution or post-review change occurred.

limitations: Blank template only; no asset is identified or present, no checks have been run, and no asset is accepted.

catalog_boundary: This catalog defines checks and a blank template only. It does not assert asset presence, test execution, approval, integration, or acceptance. Resolution, frame rate, and audio format must be compared with an approved delivery profile applicable to the asset; no universal fixed profile is implied.
